subject: ZephyrAI private deployment - network scoping & on-prem package
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@zephyr.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@zephyr.ai>, IT Ops Team <it-ops@zephyr.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZephyrAI private deployment - initial ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move forward with a private deployment (VPC peering + private endpoints) and would like to scope the on-prem package for our evaluation cluster. High-level asks:

- VPC peering from our us-west-2 VPC to Redwood Dedicated (peering + route docs)
- Private endpoint configuration for inference API + metrics endpoint
- On-prem package options (appliance vs container bundle) and required specs
- Firewall/NAT allowances and public egress ranges

Attached is a preliminary network inventory and a short list of questions from our infra team. Can we schedule a 60-min scoping call next week? Prefer Wed 5/16 morning PT.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Infrastructure
ZephyrAI

Attachments: zephyr_network_inventory.csv (CSV, 18KB); questions: see body
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@zephyr.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZephyrAI private deployment - initial ask

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the inventory. We're ready to start the scoping. Quick notes before the meeting:

- We'll need the VPC CIDR ranges you want peered and any existing peering/tunnel constraints (if you have transit gateway in front of your VPCs, let us know).
- For private endpoints we support both ALB-based endpoint + internal load balancer patterns; we'll bring a recommended flow conditioned on latency SLOs.
- On-prem package: two options — appliance (rackable, requires BMC + PXE) or container bundle (k8s + node-level GPU). I'll attach our on-prem package spec and a networking_requirements spreadsheet with the preflight checklist.
- Please share an internal Slack contact for the infra lead so we can do an operational preflight the week of the cutover.

Proposed kickoff: Wed, 16 May 2028, 09:30 PT — does that work? If so I’ll send a calendar invite and a proposed agenda (networking preflight, SOW milestones, install timeline).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onprem_package_spec.pdf (PDF, 120KB); networking_requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 32KB)
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@zephyr.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZephyrAI private deployment - initial ask

Looping in Laura (implementation PM) to lead the onboarding and Monica (CS lead) to track success criteria. A couple of items from the ops checklist we'll want to confirm during the scoping call:

- SOC2 artifacts & data retention constraints (Elena, do you require an encrypted in-transit+at-rest SLA beyond our standard?)
- Backup/restore windows for the on-prem package (we typically run nightly snapshots; can we confirm RPO/RTO targets)
- Network ACL baseline: we'll review required ports for KV cache sync, model pulls, and telemetry. See the networking_requirements.xlsx for defaults.

Agenda for Wed 5/16 09:30 PT (proposed):
1) Introductions & roles
2) Review VPC CIDRs and peering topology
3) Private endpoint pattern (ALB vs ILB) decision tree
4) On-prem package sizing + preflight items
5) Timeline & SOW next steps

If that agenda looks good we'll slot 60 minutes and I will create a brief preflight form for your infra lead.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@zephyr.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 07:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZephyrAI private deployment - initial ask

Karthik / Monica,

Apologies for the delay — we validated the inventory and answered the preflight questions. Summary:
- VPC CIDRs: 10.10.0.0/16 (primary), 10.11.0.0/16 (staging)
- We use TGW for east/west routing; attaching fw_matrix with required rules.
- Preferred private endpoint: internal ALB in our peered VPC (latency-sensitive inference).
- On-prem: we prefer the container bundle (k8s-based) for now — will consider appliance for prod later.

Also: we require encrypted-at-rest via customer-managed KMS, and an RPO of 4 hours for experiment clusters.

Proposed attendees for Wed: Ravi (infra), Elena (sre), Karthik, Monica, Laura, and your implementation lead. See attached fw_matrix.csv.

Thanks,
Ravi
IT Ops, ZephyrAI

Attachments: fw_matrix.csv (CSV, 9KB)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@zephyr.ai>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@zephyr.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZephyrAI private deployment - initial ask

Perfect — thanks for the details and the fw matrix. Wed 5/16 09:30 PT is confirmed; calendar invite sent. Quick follow-ups before the call:

- Laura will kick off the HubSpot onboarding ticket (DEAL ZEPHYR-2028-0473) and share the SOW draft; please look out for the DocuSign link after the scoping call.
- For customer-managed KMS: we support AWS KMS and external HSM via vault. Laura, can you prepare the KMS integration checklist for Wed?
- Preflight ask: Ravi/Elena can you upload the peering requester role ARN and the TGW attachments doc to the shared Drive? That will speed validation.

Action items:
- Karthik: run the private endpoint latency decision matrix during the call
- Monica: capture success criteria and cutover windows
- Laura: SOW + DocuSign prep, KMS checklist

Looking forward to the call — we’ll come with a proposed install timeline (4-week staging -> cutover window) and a risk matrix for the on-prem container bundle.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
